page.notes: Top line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Several words in the Dutch entries are hard to read and may be misprinted or misread: "Adengelstoffen", "Schorijten", "Hebreen", "Uytlecy-ding" and "Outle-drende". The Hebrew entry is only partly legible; the title "Liber Psalmorum" is clear, and the Hebrew is uncertain. The Dutch line ending "Hebreen. 4." is marked [?]. "Michinam" in the last entry may be a printing error for "Machinam". The signature reads "Ll 2" and the catchword "Joh.".
